messages:
emily: Heads-up 5 PTQ run on v2.1-reranker-int8 shows MRR drop focused on very short queries (<=9 tokens). NDCG@10 almost flat.

sanjay: OK. can you share the eval command and a couple failing qids?

emily: eval: ./eval_harness --model v2.1-int8 --holdout veryshort --metrics mrr,ndcg@10 --seed 13 --batch 128
Sample qids: qA341, qB112, qC999 (I'll dump logits in a minute).

tara: was there a recent priming change? those tiny queries are sensitive to any added prefix.

emily: yes we added a 1-line candidate priming to help intent. when I ablated priming MRR returned close to fp32.

lia: that points to margin compression during quantization. did you calibrate on primed inputs?

emily: no, the calibration set was general production traffic. I'm starting a slice-aware PTQ job with ~6k primed examples.

eval-bot: job sptq-6171 queued; will report results when done.

sanjay: also capture top1 flips and log top2/top1 ratio for flipped cases. helps decide bias-correction vs full recalibration.

emily: noted. plan: (1) slice calib, (2) run tiny bias-scan per-layer if needed, (3) fallback: conditional route config to disable priming for veryshort queries.

tara: add a pad-parity check too. left/right pad can interact with KVpack and quant rounding.

emily: added pad parity job and flip-dump to eval harness. will post artifacts when jobs finish.

lia: if slice-calib fixes it we should make slice-aware calibration a PTQ default for routes that use priming templates.

sanjay: agreed. also add a shortline to onboarding: "run PTQ on primed examples for slice-sensitive routes".

emily: will make the PR and tag you both. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
